text: It helped me understand and accept my gender identity, which I had been suppressing for years. My depression has improved a lot since I came out. I feel more like myself, and I'm much more open to exploring who I am without shame. Some days are still hard because of how people react, but inside I feel a peace I didn't have before.
Ich bin ausgeglichener und zufriedener als früher.

I feel more open to the world and to different cultures and people. Living abroad was a big step that I wouldn't have taken before. It's also made me more curious about myself, and I've become more confident.
I can't say it made a real difference

Ich verstehe besser, warum ich mich immer so überfordere, und kann besser auf mich aufpassen. Dadurch bin ich weniger erschöpft und meine Stimmung ist stabiler. Ich habe nicht mehr so oft das Gefühl, dass mir alles über den Kopf wächst.

My mental health has improved in the sense that I'm less burnt out and I have more joy in my life. I spend more time outside, I've started gardening, and I've reconnected with my parents, who I barely saw before because I was always working. I think the experience opened my eyes to how much life I was missing. I appreciate things like a slow Sunday breakfast or a walk in the rain much more. I'm still a lawyer and the job is still stressful, but I don't feel like I'm drowning anymore.
Same as before really. It was interesting but didn't do anything for my mental health either way.
Ich habe weniger Ängste und mehr Vertrauen in mich und das Leben. Ich fühle mich insgesamt leichter und fröhlicher.

I understand myself better. I see now that I ran away from things because I was afraid of being rejected, so I left before anyone could leave me. Knowing that has made me calmer and more stable, and I'm in a relationship that's lasted over a year now.
Slightly less anxious

Ich bin seitdem psychisch viel stabiler. Vor der Erfahrung hatte ich immer wieder depressive Episoden und war auch einmal wegen eines Burnouts krankgeschrieben. Heute merke ich viel früher, wenn es mir schlechter geht, und kann gegensteuern. Ich bin dankbarer für die kleinen Dinge und genieße die Zeit, die ich mir für mich nehme. Ich habe auch mehr Mitgefühl mit mir selbst entwickelt und mache mir nicht mehr so viele Vorwürfe, wenn ich nicht perfekt funktioniere. Das hat sehr viel Druck rausgenommen.
I feel more confident and self-assured, and less anxious. I'm more open to meeting new people too.

It had a negative impact on my mental health for a long time. I developed panic attacks and I was afraid to be alone at night. I also had some derealisation that scared me a lot. Therapy helped and I'm better now, but I'm still more fragile than before, and I don't think I'll ever take psychedelics again. If anything good came out of it, it's that I learned I need to look after my mental health more seriously.
Ich bin gelassener und lasse mich nicht mehr von jeder Kleinigkeit herunterziehen. Ich weiß besser, was im Leben wirklich zählt, und bin dankbarer dafür.

My anxiety in general is so much better. I used to think I would always be an anxious person, but now I feel calm most of the time. I'm also more open to trying new things, like I joined a theatre group, which I never would have dared before.
feeling way better mentally, less depressed and more open with people

Ich habe durch die Erfahrung verstanden, warum ich mich so oft schuldig fühle und warum ich mich ständig für die Gefühle anderer verantwortlich mache. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr verbessert. Ich hatte jahrelang eine leichte Depression und eine ständige innere Anspannung, die ich mir nicht erklären konnte. Jetzt weiß ich, woher das kommt, und kann besser damit umgehen. Ich bin freundlicher zu mir selbst, lasse mich nicht mehr so leicht von anderen manipulieren und habe gelernt, auch mal nein zu sagen. Die Depression ist nicht ganz weg, aber deutlich leichter geworden. Ich mache außerdem seit einem Jahr eine Therapie, in der ich das alles weiter bearbeite.
I feel more connected to my body and to the earth. More grounded and peaceful.

I feel like I know myself much better, and that has helped my mental health. I'm more aware of my needs and I take them seriously. I'm less anxious and more content, and I don't feel the constant pressure to please everyone that I used to feel. I'm more open to new perspectives too, including about myself.
Keine Auswirkung

I'm much more at peace. I used to be very anxious and always worried about something, and now I feel a sense of calm underneath it all. I appreciate my life much more and I'm grateful for small things, like being able to have coffee with my mum, even though she's sick. I think the experience showed me that every moment is precious and that I don't have to wait for things to be perfect to be happy.

I'm happier and I feel more love for my family. I used to be quite cold and distant, I think, and now I hug my kids every day and tell them I love them. My mental health is much better. I used to have a lot of anger and resentment, and that's mostly gone.
Mir geht es psychisch besser, ich bin weniger ängstlich und kann Dinge leichter loslassen.
Not really any improvement. I was a bit shaky for a while after, then normal again.

Sobriety has changed everything for my mental health. I'm less anxious, I sleep better, and I'm not depressed like I was when I was drinking. I understand myself so much better, I know my triggers, I know what my anxiety feels like, and I know what to do about it. I'm also more grateful for my life, my health, and my family, who stuck by me through all of it.
Ich bin entspannter und habe mehr Freude im Familienleben. Ich bin dankbar für das, was ich habe.
I'm more light-hearted and I don't take myself so seriously. I feel happier and more relaxed most of the time.

The experience gave me a deep appreciation for life and for this planet. I feel lucky to be here and to experience everything, even the hard parts. I'm also more open to other people's ideas, because I see that we're all just trying to figure it out on this little rock. My mental health is generally better, I'm calmer and happier.
Mir geht es besser, seit ich mehr auf mich achte. Meine Kopfschmerzen sind seltener geworden, und ich bin insgesamt ausgeglichener.
I don't think there was an impact. Fun experience, but that's all.

My mental health has improved a lot. The biggest thing is that I don't feel like a victim of my life anymore. I see the good and the bad as part of the same thing, and I'm grateful for both, because they've made me who I am. I'm more open with people and I've learned to accept help and love, which I wasn't able to before. During my divorce I was sad, but I wasn't depressed. I think the experience gave me a foundation of trust and love that I didn't have before. I feel more connected to the people in my life, my kids, my friends, my dad, and I'm more grateful for every day I get to spend with them.
Ich bin klarer im Kopf und weiß, was mir wichtig ist. Dadurch fühle ich mich weniger zerrissen und innerlich ruhiger.
My social anxiety is much less severe than it was. I feel more relaxed with people and I enjoy socialising now, which I never did before.
I feel emotionally more mature. I know what I feel and why, and that has helped me be more stable and less reactive.

Die Erfahrung hat mir ein tiefes Gefühl von Liebe und Geborgenheit gegeben. Ich fühle mich mit allem verbunden, mit der Natur, mit anderen Menschen, mit etwas Größerem. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr gestärkt. Ich bin weniger ängstlich und habe mehr Vertrauen ins Leben. Ich bin auch offener für spirituelle Fragen geworden, die ich früher abgetan hätte.
I'm generally less anxious and I feel more optimistic. Life feels more manageable.
I'm less afraid of death, and that has helped my overall anxiety, which was always connected to health worries. I'm also more grateful for being alive.
Ich fühle mich weniger einsam und habe mehr Liebe für meine Freunde und meine Familie. Ich bin offener geworden und lasse Menschen näher an mich heran.

I'm happier and more relaxed with my kids. I enjoy being a mum more, instead of just surviving. I appreciate the little moments, like bedtime stories or when they make me a drawing. I also feel less guilty all the time, which has improved my mood a lot.
Hard to say, maybe a little happier
